name: Opinionnaire® Survey analysis and Fast Forum® reports
author: NatDialogue

sections.description:
Opinionnaire® Survey analysis and Fast Forum® reports is a plugin that calculates an innovative survey metric known as the “Polarization-Consensus Rating” (PC-Rating™), originally created by Richard J. Spady in the 1970s and now adapted for WordPress by his son John I. Spady.

The plugin connects directly to the SurveyGizmo API on behalf of the user to retrieve the surveys associated with their SurveyGizmo account. The retrieved survey data is processed temporarily to generate the required reports but is neither stored nor used outside the scope of the user’s immediate interaction with the plugin. All data remains securely within the user’s environment.

This tool imports specialized Opinionnaire®-styled surveys from SurveyGizmo.com to produce a proprietary Fast Forum® report showing Polarization-Consensus Rating (PC-Rating™ cross tabs and graphics and a visualization of the overall Participatory Resistance™ to your survey questions.

Plugin Features

  • Connect your SurveyGizmo account to this plugin to download your previously created Opinionnaire® Survey and create proprietary Fast Forum® cross tab reports that showcase both the PC-Rating™ (Polarization-Consensus Rating) visualization and the Participatory Resistance chart.
  • Browse the sample data to acquaint yourself with how the plugin operates.
  • Adjust the report settings to transform your results in a number of different ways.
sections.installation:
Step 1. Upload “/opinionnaire/” directory to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory.

Step 2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Step 3. You can connect SurveyGizmo to the plugin using SurveyGizmo’s API token and API token secret, or use our sample data to see how the plugin builds reports and graphs.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin store any user data or survey information?
No. The plugin temporarily accesses survey data via the SurveyGizmo API to generate reports on behalf of the user. However, it does not store or retain any information retrieved from the API. All operations are performed in real-time, and no data is saved beyond the session.

How do I connect my SurveyGizmo account?
You can configure the plugin with your SurveyGizmo API token and API token secret under the settings menu. This allows the plugin to retrieve surveys directly associated with your account.

Who can I contact for support?
Questions about this plugin should be directed to John Spady: jspady@NationalDialogueNetwork.org
